def M4_S1_SingleWriter():
    for shard_id in range(NUM_SHARDS):
        holders = []
        for worker_id in range(NUM_WORKERS):
            w = workers[worker_id]
            if (w.status == "active" and
                    w.held_lease_epoch[shard_id] >= 0 and
                    w.held_lease_epoch[shard_id] == shards[shard_id].fence_epoch):
                holders.append(worker_id)
        if len(holders) > 1:
            return False
    return True

# M4-S2: Self-fence precedence — a worker that has been isolated for
# SELF_FENCE_AFTER steps must be terminated (cannot commit).
# We encode this by checking that no active worker has isolation_steps >= SELF_FENCE_AFTER.
